Keywords.name: Action
Keywords.text: An action card usually for increasing the partner's arousal.

Keywords.name: Arousal
Keywords.text: If arousal reaches maximum and no edges are left, the date is over.

Keywords.name: Blocker
Keywords.text: Blocker type card. Provides a usually negative effect while in hand.

Keywords.name: Beats Per Minute
Keywords.text: The beats per minute X the metronome is set to for the duration of the effect.

Keywords.name: Clothing
Keywords.text: Clothing type card. Remains active in the slot until explicitely discarded by an effect or overwritten.

Keywords.name: Combo
Keywords.text: Increase combo by X. Each combo adds a 50% gain to arousal.

Keywords.name: Discard
Keywords.text: Discard X number of cards from hand to the discard pile if possible.

Keywords.name: Draw
Keywords.text: Draw X number of cards. If the draw pile is empty, reshuffle once first.

Keywords.name: Edge
Keywords.text: If arousal reaches maximum an instance of edge is consumed.

Keywords.name: Female

Keywords.name: Male
Keywords.text: Male gendered card or effect.

Keywords.name: No Gender
Keywords.text: Not gendered card or effect.

Keywords.name: Re-Shuffle
Keywords.text: Shuffle the deck and discard pile back into your deck.

Keywords.name: Scry
Keywords.text: Look at the top X cards of the deck and put any number of them on the bottom in any order, and put the rest back on top in any order.
